name: Miracle Maker Shampoo
description: Haircare for men and women, designed to gently cleanse the scalp.
howToUse: Apply to wet hair, gently massage into the scalp, then rinse thoroughly. Repeat if needed.
recommendedUse: Use 2-3 times per week or as needed, depending on your hair-washing routine.

name: Miracle Maker Conditioner
description: Conditioning care for men and women, for softer, smoother hair.

Helps protect hair and enhance its natural shine
howToUse: After shampooing, apply the conditioner to wet hair, focusing on the lengths and ends. Leave on for 5 to 10 minutes, then rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water.
recommendedUse: Use 2-3 times per week or as needed, depending on your hair-washing routine.

name: Secret Hair Oil
description: Hair oil for men and women, designed for scalp and hair care.
benefits: Promotes longer, thicker and healthier hair
howToUse: Shake well before use. Apply the oil to damp or dry hair. Massage your scalp for 5-10 minutes, then leave on for 45-60 minutes.
